verdict.rationale: Docs mention 'Sync and manage websites' and content import via API (createContentImportSource), implying re-syncing of website sources, but there is no explicit documentation of scheduled or change-triggered automatic re-syncing across all source types (docs, help centers, files) without manual re-upload. missing for 10: explicit scheduling/cron documentation for content refresh, confirmation of automatic change-detection re-sync for non-website sources (PDFs, articles), and independent/hands-on verification that sync happens without manual re-upload.
